claims.claim: The public brand is operated by the legal insurer named in the annual report.
claims.rationale: Annual report and registry identity records establish the fictional legal names.

claims.claim: Published non-contracted reimbursement is calculated against the insurer-defined tariff basis, not necessarily the provider invoice.
claims.rationale: Policy guide describes the basis; actual claim-level outcomes are not modelled.

claims.claim: The headline hospital percentage describes a directory denominator, not practical access to every specialty or location.
claims.rationale: Network annex defines the denominator; capacity and waiting time remain unknown.

claims.claim: Published complaint/service metrics are directly comparable across the three companies.
claims.rationale: The source definitions, numerators and denominators differ materially.

claims.claim: The insurer uses at least one third-party provider for administrative workflows.
claims.rationale: Company schedule/technical or board appendix plus supplier register; complete data-processing terms are not public.

claims.claim: A named care pathway guarantees an appointment within a specific time.
claims.rationale: No source provides a complete patient-level waiting-time distribution.

claims.claim: The 82% two-day metric applies to every claim received.
claims.rationale: Metric note excludes incomplete, pending-document and manual-review cases.

claims.claim: All claims processing stopped during the October 2026 interruption.
claims.rationale: Incident report says routine app claims continued while document cases queued.
